newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Komercni sees gradual fall in Czech interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Komercni sees gradual fall in Czech interest rates.

text.p: Komercni Banka a.s., the Czech Republic's largest commercial bank, said on Friday it expected further gradual falls in Czech interest rates on lower inflation expectations.

"At the beginning of 1997, the interest rate (six-month interbank offered rate) starts to incorporate expectations of future slowdown in inflation which leads and will lead to further moderate and gradual declines in interest rates," Komercni said in a regular economic forecast.
Six-month PRIBOR stood on Friday at 12.05 percent.
The CNB's repo rate remains 12.4 percent, while its discount rate has been at 10.5 percent since last June when monetary policy was tightened and rate was raised a full percentage point.
Inflation in January slowed to 7.4 percent, year-on-year, from 8.6 percent in December. -- Prague newsroom, 42 2 2423 0003
